title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
You’ll be a Technical Leader, unblock the engineering team by resolving complex technical impasses, standardising engineering practices, and owning cross-functional initiatives.

You'll still be a highly hands-on engineer, responsible for rapidly prototyping, shipping MVPs, and turning product ideas into polished user experiences. You’ll work across the stack, collaborating closely with product, design, and engineering teams while operating with a high degree of independence.

What you'll do 

- Build and ship new product features end-to-end

- Lead rapid prototyping and MVP development

- Develop modern frontend applications using TypeScript, Vue 3 Composition API, and Tailwind

- Contribute to backend services using Node, Bun, Koa, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and AWS

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to shape product direction

- Improve performance, reliability, and developer experience across the platfor

- Support on hiring, performance and technical roadmaps. 

What you'll need 

- Extensive experience building modern frontend applications with TypeScript and Vue3

- Solid backend experience with Node-based services and relational databases

- Experience working with PostgreSQL, Prisma, AWS, and REST APIs

- Comfortable moving quickly, making pragmatic decisions, and shipping iteratively

- Strong communication and collaboration skills

- Able to work independently in a hybrid environment

- Ideally have been in early stage start-ups going through growth and technical challenges

What you'll get: 

- Share options - If Cytix wins, you should too.

- Unlimited Holidays! 

- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay. 

- Pension - 8% (3% employer, 5% employee)

- Private Healthcare through Vitality including dental, optical and hearing

- Work from anywhere (WFA) 

- Claude Tokens 

- Celebrate your birthday with a day off work 

- Octopus car scheme - Drive an electric car through salary sacrifice

- Inclusivity as standard - A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks.
About Cytix 

- Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. 

- That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

Compensation: £100K – £120K • + Equity

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Databases Tempo | Canada | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs . We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada. 

The Opportunity: 

We build Tempo , the open-source distributed tracing backend behind Grafana Cloud Traces and Grafana Enterprise Traces (GET). Tempo makes it easy to search traces, generate metrics from spans, and connect tracing data with logs, metrics, and profiles across the Grafana stack.

2026 is an inflection point for Tempo. After a major architectural upgrade and the launch of TraceQL metrics, we are shifting from foundational work to product and operational excellence, and evolving Tempo from a SaaS database into a platform that powers Grafana’s next generation of observability products (App Observability, Asserts, Traces Drilldown, and AI-driven assistants).

Over the next year, you will help us:

- Make Grafana Cloud Traces “just work” for customers by eliminating rough edges, confusing limits, and hidden failure modes.

- Achieve operational excellence at scale as we grow from close to 50 cells today into triple digits this year, with autoscaling, parameterized rollouts, and aggressive toil reduction.

- Evolve Tempo into a platform enabler: higher-density APIs, trace aggregation, TraceQL metrics math, and machine/LLM-friendly interfaces that downstream products and agents can build on.

- Push performance further: faster query latency at hundreds of MB/s ingestion and performant 30-day query ranges to match competitors.

- Prepare Tempo for an agent-driven world: larger, burstier, higher-cardinality workloads, and new categories of AI-powered workflows, such as assistant-driven triage and “why is this slow?”- style investigations.

What You’ll Be Doing: 

As a Senior Engineer on Tempo, you will own technical direction on the hardest problems in our roadmap and raise the bar across the team.

- 
Deliver significant technical projects. Take well-scoped, multi-month initiatives from problem framing through rollout, e.g., trace aggregation APIs, Limitless Tempo, autoscaling cells and customer limits, or query engine improvements. Partner with Staff engineers and the tech lead on broader, cross-team direction.

- 
Own major components of Tempo. Contribute to and own parts of ingestion, storage, query, and metrics generation. Write and present design docs, participate in design reviews, make sound trade-offs on performance, cost, and complexity, and document the “why” for the team.

- 
Build APIs for humans and agents. Help shape the next generation of Tempo’s interfaces (structured, deterministic, discoverable) so that Act 3 products, LLM-driven assistants, and external integrators can build on Tempo reliably.

- 
Contribute to operational excellence. Own outcomes for the areas you build against concrete SLOs (P99 write latency, incident recurrence, TCO per ingested GB), and help move the team toward Zero Ops through automation, parameterized rollouts, and actionable alerts.

- 
Collaborate with Product and sibling teams. Work with PMs and with App Observability, Asserts, Drilldown, and Grafana Assistant teams to understand how Tempo gets consumed and to ship what unblocks them.

- 
Mentor and support engineers. Raise the bar through thorough code review, constructive design feedback, and pairing, especially with junior and mid-level engineers.

- 
Participate in on-call for the services you help build, and contribute to incident response and post-incident learning.

- 
Contribute to open source. Tempo is OSS. You will engage the community, review external contributions, and contribute to the project in the open.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

Example problems you could work on 

These are the kinds of projects landing in 2026:

- 
Trace aggregation and higher-density APIs: extend TraceQL metrics, design LLM-friendly response types, and make Tempo a first-class data source for Grafana’s AI assistant.

- 
Autoscaling end-to-end: customer limits and Tempo cells, with hysteresis, predictive scaling for spikes, and safe scale-down.

- 
Agent-scale ingestion and query: guardrails for bursty, high-cardinality, agent-generated workloads.

- 
Query performance: new data formats, smarter query pipelines, targeted optimizations for common Drilldown and Traces workflows, and 30-day query ranges.

- 
Rollouts and multi-cell operations: parameterized rollouts, push-button deploys, and the tooling to grow safely into triple-digit cell counts without a proportional increase in alert noise.

- 
Limits and self-service: drive customer-facing configuration and observability so escalations trend toward zero.

What Makes You a Great Fit: 

- 
Technical ownership. A track record of delivering complex, multi-month projects that spanned design, delivery, and operations, and of helping the teammates around you grow.

- 
Solid systems experience. Significant hands-on experience building and operating distributed data systems in production: ingestion pipelines, storage engines, query execution, or similar.

- 
Strong software craftsmanship. You write clean, robust, performant software that others can maintain, and you know when to optimize vs. when to ship.

- 
Strong Go, or a path to it. We write Tempo in Go. Solid experience in other systems languages (Rust, C, C++) translates well.

- 
Operational mindset. You’ve owned production services, carried a pager, reduced toil, and treated SLOs as a product feature, not a chore.

- 
Customer focus and pragmatism. You break complex problems into short feedback loops: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate.

- 
Collaboration and clear writing. You contribute through design docs, reviews, and shipped code, and you communicate clearly in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For: 

- Experience with tracing, OpenTelemetry, or large-scale observability systems.

- Experience designing query languages, SQL/TraceQL-like engines, or APIs intended to be consumed programmatically (by services or agents).

- Experience with columnar storage formats (e.g., Parquet) or purpose-built on-disk formats for analytical workloads.

- Experience operating multi-tenant, multi-cell SaaS infrastructure at scale on Kubernetes.

- Experience building for AI/LLM consumers: structured APIs, metadata/discovery endpoints, deterministic outputs, evaluation harnesses.

- Open-source contribution or maintainership, and comfort engaging a community in the open.

- Experience as an on-call user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, or Tempo in a previous role (or on a homelab).

- Experience in a fully remote, globally distributed team.

How we work 

We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our senior engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.

In Canada, the OTE (On-Target Earnings)/Base compensation range for this role is CAD $164,490 - $197,389. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs ' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. 

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs :

- 
100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

- 
Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

- 
Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

- 
Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

- 
Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

- 
Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

- 
Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

- 
Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

- 
Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

- 
In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 

- 
Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. 

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. 

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. - Strong industry experience in Machine Learning, dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.

- Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.

- Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.

- Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.

- Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).

Nice to Have 

- Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.

- Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.

- Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.

- Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.

- Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.

- Strong communication skills.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

About the role 

We're looking for a Senior or Lead Security Engineer (Detection & Response) to build out the next generation of detection systems.

You'll sit within the team responsible for security across our IT and cloud environment, spanning AWS, identity, endpoints, SaaS and data center infrastructure. You'll own security monitoring and detection end-to-end: anticipating how our systems could be compromised, ensuring we have the right telemetry to see it, and building the detections and response workflows to act on it.

Think of it like SRE for security. We want someone who can answer questions like: Has this account been compromised? Is someone accessing AWS who shouldn't be? Has an attacker moved laterally through our network? How would we know? 

You'll also lead investigations and incident response, automate repetitive security work, and work with IT and Engineering to fix the underlying problems you uncover.

Responsibilities

- Own security monitoring and detection across AWS, identity, endpoints, SaaS, networks and data center environments
- Build and maintain the telemetry and logging pipelines needed to detect security incidents, and continuously test and improve detection coverage
- Lead security investigations and incident response from detection through containment, recovery and post-mortem
- Proactively hunt for threats and identify gaps in our visibility, controls and detection coverage
- Build automation to improve detection, investigation and response, making effective use of AI and emerging tools to improve efficiency and capabilities.
- Work closely with IT and Engineering to turn security findings into preventative controls and better system design
- Develop and test incident response playbooks and continuously improve our response capability
- Implement and enhance internal AI agents and security bots that assist with monitoring, investigations, reporting, and other security operation tasks.
Requirements 

- Significant hands-on experience in detection engineering, security engineering, incident response, threat hunting or a similar technical role 
- Strong understanding of cloud environments, ideally AWS, and how to monitor them for unauthorised or suspicious activity
- Strong networking fundamentals and an understanding of how attackers move through networks and systems
- Strong understanding of attacker tradecraft and the ability to turn it into useful, high-signal detections
- Experience investigating real security incidents and taking ownership through to resolution
- Strong scripting or programming skills, ideally Python, and a habit of automating repetitive work

description:
We are looking for a Data Engineering Team Lead to lead the Data Platform team at DataSnipper.

Every decision DataSnipper makes about its products runs through the data platform: which features land, which customers are getting value, what we bill for, what we fix next, and which AI capabilities add the most value. You will lead a team of two data engineers who own the systems that make that possible. That means how usage events get captured across a growing set of products, how they become trustworthy models in Snowflake, and how Customer Success, Product and GTM get to answers without waiting on us.

This is a player-coach role in a small, high-ownership team . You are responsible for the people, the roadmap and the technical direction, and you stay hands-on enough to ship alongside the team and make architectural calls credibly. At DataSnipper, Team Lead is our entry point into engineering management: the same people, delivery and product responsibilities as an Engineering Manager, on a smaller team.

We are a handful of people serving the whole company, so your judgment about what not to build matters as much as what the team ships.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.

What your team owns

The Data Platform team works across three areas:

- Data Platform : reliable, scalable infrastructure that gets the right data to the right place

- Internal Analytics : a self-service platform so every team can be data-informed without a ticket

- Customer-facing Analytics : the dashboards and exports customers use to see the value they get from DataSnipper

Concretely, you would be walking into billions of usage events flowing from our Excel Add-in, web apps and product backends through Azure Event Hubs into Snowflake ; a dbt estate built on medallion principles and managed in dbt Cloud ; Terraform-managed Snowflake and Azure infrastructure; and a set of product teams shipping AI agents faster than we can instrument them .

You will also find real, named open problems rather than a tidy platform: event capture mid-consolidation, multiple methods of user attribution, and a data quality layer that is designed but not yet built. We would rather tell you that up front.

What you will do

Lead the team

- Lead a team of two data engineers through outcomes, not tasks : set clear goals with the team and trust them to figure out how

- Make the team measurably better: raise the engineering bar, grow each engineer into bigger problems, and address performance issues directly when they arise

- Run regular 1:1s, give clear and timely feedback, and own each engineer's goals and development

- Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, documentation and operational excellence

- Take part in hiring and help shape the team's scope as it evolves

Own direction and delivery

- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and GTM to shape the team's roadmap , turning vague data requests into scoped, well-defined work

- Make the trade-offs a small team serving the whole company needs: what to build, what to defer, and when a request shouldn't become a pipeline

- Set the technical direction and make the architectural calls that shape the team's systems

- Keep Snowflake performance and cost , tech debt, dependencies and compliance obligations (audit logging, vulnerability remediation, Vanta evidence) visible and under control

- Be the person other engineering teams come to when they need to instrument something new

Stay hands-on in the data platform

- Contribute to the event ingestion architecture end to end: Azure Event Hubs, Snowpipe, Fivetran, and our shared Python/TypeScript event client libraries

- Build and review dbt transformation pipelines that stay reliable as volume, source count and model complexity grow

- Define and enforce event contracts and schemas so product teams can instrument new features without silent breakage downstream

- Evolve the core data models (event, user, license, company) and integrate new sources such as product backends, MongoDB, HubSpot and billing

- Guide reverse ETL and activation work that pushes modeled data back into HubSpot, MongoDB, Postgres and GTM reporting

What you bring

Leadership

- At least 1 year leading engineers as a team lead or engineering manager: 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, performance, and development

- An empowerment style of leadership : you lead through outcomes and trust, not by assigning tasks

- Early evidence of growing engineers and raising a team's bar, and the willingness to address performance issues directly

- Strong product aptitude : you can challenge the framing of a request, translate stakeholder needs into technical solutions, and make roadmap trade-offs

Data engineering

- 7+ years in data engineering or a closely related backend/platform role, with a track record of owning a data platform area end to end

- Deep SQL and strong Python , including query optimization and performance tuning on a cloud warehouse

- Production experience with a cloud data warehouse (we use Snowflake ) and a modern transformation framework (we use dbt )

- Experience with event-driven / streaming ingestion and its failure modes: schema drift, duplication, late data, backfills

- Experience on a cloud platform at the infrastructure level (we're on Azure ; AWS/GCP transfers fine)

- Solid data modeling fundamentals and the ability to defend a modeling decision to both engineers and business stakeholders

- Experience operating data systems in production with a focus on reliability, observability and maintainability

How you work

- Excellent communication in English and genuine comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders

- Bias to action, a strong sense of ownership, and the judgment to prioritize when demand exceeds capacity

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a startup or scale-up , ideally as an early member of a data team

- Experience hiring engineers or helping a team expand its scope

- Experience with product analytics tooling (Mixpanel, RudderStack) and warehouse-native BI (Netspring/Optimizely Analytics, Omni, Embeddable, or similar)

- Experience building data products for AI or agent consumption : semantic layers, metrics layers, MCP servers, or governed self-service access

- Experience with Terraform , Docker and data governance at scale

- Reverse ETL experience and familiarity with CRM data models (HubSpot, Salesforce) or customer success platforms

What we offer

- Being part of one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands

- Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us

- A step into engineering management, with Engineering Manager scope on a small team

- 28 vacation days

- Excellent salary

- Pension plan

- Stock participation plan

- Hybrid work (Amsterdam-based)

- International team and environment

- Daily lunch

- Mental health support (OpenUp)

- Social events and team activities

Recruitment steps

- Recruiter screen

- Hiring Manager interview

- System design interview

- Product interview

- Final interviews with Engineering leadership

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience. 

Our hiring decisions are merit based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role. 

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you. 

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper

title: Commercial Data Scientist
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)

Commercial Data Scientist 

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. 

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S. 

As a Commercial Data Scientist , you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.

How you’ll make an impact: 

- Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.

- Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights & Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.

- Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.

- Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.

- Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations

The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team 

As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.

- Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

- Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.

- Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.

- Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.

- Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.

About you: 

- At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.

- Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment

- Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.

- Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques

- Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

- Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.

- Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.

- Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.

- Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.

- Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.

Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team 

- We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.

- Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.

- The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.

- We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!

Compensation 

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Our total compensation package may include:

- Base salary

- Equity (where applicable)

- Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits 

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance

- 401(k) with company match

- Flexible paid time off and company holidays

- Paid parental leave

- Professional development and learning opportunities

- Wellness and mental health resources

- Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)

Why You'll Love Working Here 

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

- Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.

- Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.

- Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.

- Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.

- Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools 

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity 

Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. 

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-commercial-data-scientist

If you're excited by high-impact, high-visibility engineering work this could be a great fit. This team turns key account commitments into real, shippable products so Fleetio can win strategic deals and support those customers long-term. The engineers in this role will directly influence outcomes for key accounts and help close some of the largest deals at Fleetio.

More About Our Team and Company

You’re a product-minded, delivery-oriented engineer who can operate in high-trust environments. You can take ambiguous problems and turn them into clear plans and high-quality shipped software. You’re comfortable collaborating directly with Sales and Customer Success partners to translate customer and deal context into product capabilities. This work includes quick discovery, rapid scoping, and clear communication about tradeoffs and timelines.

You’re independently successful: you take ownership from start to finish, stay tenacious through ambiguity, and consistently find a way to deliver.

You care about maintainability and operational excellence.

Your impact

- Build solutions that meet Fleetio's product and engineering standards: testing, observability, maintainability, documented

Your experience

- Experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders, translating needs into technical plans, and managing expectations.

- Ability to decompose complex requests into milestones and deliver incrementally.

- Strong written communication and comfort working in a remote, async-friendly environment.

Nice to have

- Experience working on a large-scale Ruby on Rails application.

- Experience working on customer-facing platform/product capabilities that support enterprise accounts.

- Experience partnering with go-to-market teams (Sales, Customer Success) on delivery of time-sensitive commitments.

Benefits

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.

To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com 

We are seeking a Senior Mobile Engineer to take ownership of the Mattermost mobile experience for teams working in defense, intelligence, and critical infrastructure. Our users operate in DDIL environments where connectivity may be disconnected, denied, intermittent, or limited, security is non-negotiable, and the software they depend on has to keep working.

Our mobile app is primarily React Native and TypeScript today, with native iOS and Android integrations. Your immediate focus will be making that experience more reliable and performant. Over time, you'll also help shape the next generation of our cross-platform mobile architecture.

You'll work hands-on across application and native layers, partner closely with platform and feature teams, work directly with customer-facing teams on field reports from constrained environments, and help raise the bar for how we observe, diagnose, and build mobile software.

Responsibilities

Reliability and Performance 

- Architect the app for DDIL and other constrained network environments

- Improve data and functional reliability across connection lifecycle, synchronization, recovery, and failure scenarios

- Own crash-free and release-health outcomes, using telemetry to proactively identify regressions and drive them through diagnosis to resolution

- Profile and improve performance across startup, networking, storage, rendering, memory, and battery usage

Mobile Platform Ownership 

- Own critical iOS and Android integrations and the boundaries between native and cross-platform code

- Maintain and evolve platform capabilities including push notifications, background execution, secure storage, app lifecycle, and real-time communications

- Build within mobile distribution and device-management constraints, including App Store, enterprise and MDM deployment, AppConfig, and Intune MAM

- Diagnose production issues from native traces, telemetry, device profiling, and sparse field logs

- Make architecture recommendations that balance near-term delivery with the long-term direction of the mobile platform

Craft and Delivery 

- Mentor engineers on mobile architecture, reliability, performance, and platform best practices

- Uphold security and compliance standards required by government and enterprise customers

- Contribute to the open-source codebase

- Use AI coding tools effectively, applying strong engineering judgment to increase output without compromising reliability or quality

What We Are Looking For

We care about what you've built and the problems you've solved — not how long you've been building. If you have strong outcomes to speak to in mobile engineering, we want to hear from you.

Required: 

- Deep expertise in iOS or Android development, with strong working knowledge of the other platform

- Strong understanding of mobile architecture, platform SDKs, lifecycle constraints, and networking fundamentals

- Experience building reliable mobile systems that behave predictably through unreliable connectivity, local state changes, synchronization, and recovery

- Strong mobile performance profiling and production debugging skills on real devices

- Experience using production data, crash metrics, and release-health signals to drive reliability improvements

- Experience making architecture recommendations and owning technical outcomes

- Ability and willingness to work across native and cross-platform codebases

- AI fluency and experience using coding agents to increase engineering output while applying judgment to ensure reliable outcomes

Preferred: 

- Experience with React Native and TypeScript

- Experience with mobile persistence, synchronization, or offline-capable systems

- Experience with real-time communications or platform media frameworks such as WebRTC, CallKit, or Android audio APIs

- Experience with enterprise mobile distribution, MDM, AppConfig, or Intune MAM

- Experience building mobile software for security-sensitive, regulated, or operationally constrained environments

- Open-source contributions

Why Mattermost

- Mission-driven work: Your contributions directly support the organizations and missions that depend on secure, reliable collaboration including the U.S. Department of War and critical infrastructure operators worldwide

- Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere with a globally distributed, high-trust team built for autonomy and ownership

- AI-forward environment: We actively adopt and build AI-enabled workflows. Agentic development is core craft here, not a novelty

- End-to-end ownership: Ship and own complex software across the full stack with real accountability for what you build

- Open source at the core: Be part of a vibrant developer community shaping the future of secure collaboration

Compensation

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

Target Salary Range: $165,000 – $215,000 

U.S. Eligibility & Compliance

This role may require obtaining and maintaining a U.S. government security clearance. Candidates must meet federal eligibility requirements to be considered.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for access to export-controlled information as defined by U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR. For more information visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls .

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.

We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.

Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.

If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to assist.

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. 

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. 

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. 

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. 

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout 

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge 

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff 

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most 

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs 

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers 

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context 

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior 

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts 

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone 

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks 

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles 

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails 

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates 

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes 

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. 

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved 

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response 

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal 

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) 

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling 

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design 

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) 

• Conversation design or UX writing experience 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan 

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO 

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave 

• Health & wellness initiatives

title: Senior Solutions Architect (OEM)
description:
About Aiven 

Aiven is the open source based data platform that builders trust to run PostgreSQL®, Apache Kafka®, ClickHouse®, OpenSearch®, Valkey™ and more in production, on any cloud. Builders ship faster. Their companies run on data that stays available, secure + under control.

The role 

You are the technical owner of Aiven's strategic OEM partnerships, from the first pre-sales conversation to production at volume and beyond. OEM partners embed the Aiven platform inside their own products, so their architecture decisions become ours at scale: one design choice gets copied across hundreds of their customers. You win the technical evaluation, run the proof of concept, design the architecture, and stay on as the person both sides trust to say what should be built, what should be automated + what should be cut.

You work AI-native. Agents handle deployment analysis, usage monitoring, rightsizing, PoC scaffolding + first-draft documentation; your time goes on the judgment calls, the partner's engineers + the hard integration problems. You own how your work gets done and redesign it as the tools improve, without waiting for a playbook.

Life at Aiven 

Our values shape how we work. Get it done, together: we move with urgency, align on shared outcomes + put our effort where customers feel it most. Invent + impress: we challenge the status quo + bring different perspectives to hard problems. We commit + deliver: we own our commitments + do what we say.

In this role, that means working with Sales, Technical Account Managers, Product, Engineering + Support on every partner, being the person partners trust to follow through, and moving faster than the partner's other vendors. We know what needs doing; the risk is being slow.

Diverse perspectives make better ideas. Come as you are. We hire for how you think + what you can do.

What we offer: stock options, an individual learning budget + coaching, flexible working hours + hybrid working, private health + dental care, and the equipment you need.

What you will do 

Win the technical evaluation 

- Partner with Sales as the technical lead through the OEM sales cycle: discovery, architecture proposals, objection handling + commercial-technical trade-offs.

- Scope + run proofs of concept that answer the partner's real question, using agents to scaffold environments, generate test data + document results so the PoC takes days, not weeks.

- Translate complex technical detail into clear business value for non-technical buyers, and the reverse for engineers.

Design the architecture 

- Develop and maintain expert-level knowledge of the Aiven platform: every service, feature and limit.

- Understand each OEM partner's customer use cases, then design and evolve robust, scalable, secure architectures that set them up right from day one, for the workloads they run today and the ones they are building next

- Guide partners in building architectures that support their customers' use cases, with best practices and tailored recommendations.

- Work with AI to continuously improve existing processes to build efficiency in the work with partners 

Enable the partner, from roll-out to growth 

- Get partners up and running: integrate Aiven into their infrastructure + workflows via APIs, SDKs, Terraform + best practices, and solve the problems that block go-live.

- Actively contribute to partner stability, enablement + growth: help partners consume Aiven services well, so utilisation + value grow together.

- Work with partners on clear positioning of their Aiven-powered solutions to their customers.

- Run technical training + workshops for partner teams, including how to build, operate + support the platform with agents in the loop.

- Keep reference architectures + integration guides current, with agents drafting from real deployments and you owning accuracy.

Own the relationship + the resolution 

- Build trust-based relationships with partner engineering teams, technical decision makers + the Aiven sales reps you work alongside.

- Act as the technical liaison between partners and Product, Engineering + Support.

- When a partner is blocked, own it end-to-end across teams rather than handing it off.

- Close the loop fast: partner feedback becomes Product + Engineering tickets the same week, with evidence attached.

What you bring 

- 5+ years in solutions architecture, pre-sales, solutions engineering or technical consulting for software or cloud infrastructure, with production experience across data technologies such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, ClickHouse or similar.

- Experience with OEM, embedded or ISV partnerships, where your architecture ships inside someone else's product.

- A record of running proofs of concept that address real business requirements and convert to production.

- Fluency in at least one programming language, such as Java, Python or Go, and comfort in Linux: installation, securing systems, storage + networking basics like DNS.

- Working knowledge of at least one public cloud (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure) across compute, storage (block + object), networking + security.

- Hands-on experience with streaming frameworks (Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, Spark Streaming or Kinesis) and a strong understanding of search ecosystems (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch or Lucene).

- Daily, hands-on use of AI tools + agents in your technical work, with examples of work you have redesigned or cut as a result.

- High agency: a record of owning problems end-to-end across teams without waiting for a blueprint.

- Clear communication with engineers, executives + non-technical buyers, written + spoken, in English, and the ability to build trust quickly with both internal sales reps and external partners.

- Self Development: In Aiven we’ve a budget to assist continuous learning and the right person will be self motivated to push their boundaries.

Nice to have 

- Multi-cloud experience across AWS, Google Cloud + Azure.

- Terraform, Kubernetes + infrastructure-as-code in production.

- Familiarity with distributed storage, NoSQL databases + data lakes.

- Comfort with usage based or consumption pricing, and with using usage data to spot risk + opportunity.

- Public speaking or technical writing for a developer audience.

- Contributions to open source projects.

How we measure success 

- Partner growth is our top priority

- Technical win rate on OEM opportunities you lead, and PoC-to-production conversion.

- Partner time-to-production for new integrations, falling over time.

- Optimisation recommendations delivered + adopted by partners.

- Cost or performance issues caught before the partner's customers see them.

- Partner feedback turned into shipped product changes.

- Ambassador output: blogs, talks + webinars delivered each year.

- Reusable assets (agents, reference architectures, playbooks) adopted by the wider SA team.

- Share of time on partner-facing work vs. analysis + documentation, trending the right way quarter on quarter.

Amazing! What’s next: 

If you think Aiven is the place for you and that our Values align with yours, send us your resume and we’ll get in touch!

Our global benefits are designed to help you thrive and grow, personally and professionally:

- Participate in Aiven’s equity plan.

- Balance work and life with our hybrid work policy.

- Choose the equipment you need to set yourself up for success.

- Use your Professional Development Plan budget for learning opportunities.

- Receive holistic wellbeing support through our global Employee Assistance Program.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (AI Agent) - UK
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. 

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

At Cresta, the AI Agent team is on a mission to create state-of-the-art AI Agents that solve practical problems for our customers. We are focused on leveraging the latest technologies in Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agent systems, while ensuring that the solutions we develop are cost-effective, secure, and reliable. 

As an AI Agent Engineer , you'll be at the forefront of deploying AI agents that address real-world challenges. In this role, you will work closely with customers as well as our software and machine learning engineers, ensuring high-impact AI Agent deployments and contributing to the continuous improvement of our core AI platform. You’ll develop intelligent AI agents, integrate them seamlessly with external systems and offer hands-on technical expertise to ensure successful deployments.. This position requires strong engineering skills, adaptability, and customer engagement. If you are self-driven, analytical, and eager to leverage AI in practical applications, this role is for you.

What You'll Do :

- AI Agent Development: Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents using Cresta’s AI platform and tools.

- System Integration: Build AI agent integrations with external systems (APIs, databases, CRMs, etc.) to ensure seamless workflow integration.

- Performance Optimization: Optimize AI agent performance (e.g. fine-tune prompts and configurations) and troubleshoot issues in complex enterprise environments.

- Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to gather technical requirements and translate business needs into AI Agent solutions.

- Demos & Iteration: Conduct interactive demos and present compelling proof-of-concepts to prospective customers, proactively gather feedback, and iteratively refine solutions to meet objectives.

- Project Coordination: Define project milestones, create implementation plans, and coordinate execution with internal teams to ensure on-time delivery. Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through real-world deployment learnings.

- Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate with PMs to define agent goals, iterate rapidly based on customer feedback, and shape product capabilities that maximize customer ROI.

- Technical Guidance: Serve as a trusted technical advisor for the customer, guiding best practices for AI agent adoption and usage. Provide technical guidance on AI agent best practices, including architecture design, security considerations, and scalability planning.

What We're Looking For: 

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

- Experience: 3+ years of experience of full time working experience in software development/ consulting, AI/ML engineering, or system integration, or as FDE

- Programming Skills: Proficiency in Python and Golang, with the ability to write clean, efficient code.

- AI/ML Knowledge: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.

- AI Agent Frameworks: Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Hands-on experience of building such a system is strongly preferred.

- Cloud & DevOps: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).

- Integration Expertise: Hands-on experience with integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.

- Communication: Excellent communication and project management skills.

title: Software Engineer III | AI/ML
description:
At ExtraHop , we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. 

Position Summary 

ExtraHop is at the forefront of innovation in the cybersecurity space, delivering cutting-edge Network Detection and Response (NDR) solutions that empower organizations to detect, respond to, and mitigate cyber risks in real time.

Join ExtraHop as a Software Engineer III and help us build a fault-resilient, highly available, and customer-centric platform. In this role you will work as part of a collaborative engineering team to build a scalable and secure platform and deliver customer-facing AI/ML features that enable security teams to stop threats in their tracks. This is a rewarding opportunity for an engineer who is obsessed with customer success, passionate about building reliable software, and learning new technologies that contribute to AI/ML-powered security capabilities in the RevealX platform."

Our services and features are written primarily in Python, Golang, TypeScript, and React, with a focus on security, scalability, stability, and type-first design. Our team develops public REST APIs, solves database scalability challenges, implements data migrations, and enables configuration management across our fleet of services. The R(x) 360 Platform is built on AWS and GCP and utilizes Terraform to define Infrastructure-as-Code across our services and high-throughput data pipelines.

Key Responsibilities 

- Develop, test, and maintain software components that support AI/ML models, agentic processes, and data pipelines.

- Contribute to the monitoring, evaluation, and improvement of algorithms used in behavioral detectors.

- Participate in agile development processes, code reviews, and technical discussions.

- Collaborate with senior engineers, data scientists, and threat researchers to integrate AI/ML features into the broader product architecture.

- Implement well-scoped features and technical improvements with limited guidance from senior team members.

- Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to engineering standards and best practices.

- Help identify and address technical debt to continually improve our codebase and technical stack.

- Stay current on the latest cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies to contribute to product enhancements.

- Assist in the documentation of product features, technical specifications, and engineering guides.

- Support a culture of curiosity, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 4+ years of professional software development experience, preferably in backend, cloud, or security related systems.

- Solid knowledge of Python, Go, or an equivalent programming language, with strong general programming fundamentals.

- Familiarity with building distributed, highly available cloud based systems, preferably on AWS.

- Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile development practices.

- Familiarity with containerization technologies (Kubernetes, Docker).

- Strong problem-solving skills, a self-starter mentality, and the ability to take ownership and deliver well-defined technical tasks.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently with limited guidance in a fast-paced team environment.

- Desire to grow in the intersection of software engineering, cybersecurity, and AI/Machine Learning

Preferred Qualifications 

- Familiarity with machine learning, statistics, actuarial modeling, or a related quantitative discipline.

- Experience with cloud services on AWS or Azure (EKS / RDS / S3 / SQS / EC2 / IAM).

- Experience with infrastructure as a software tooling, such as HashiCorp (Packer, Vault, Terraform).

- Experience in API development, PostgreSQL database design, or SQL query performance optimization.

- Familiarity with machine learning applications in cybersecurity or NDR environments.

- Knowledge of tools and frameworks commonly used in network detection and response.

- Understanding of threat detection, intrusion prevention, and incident response strategies.

The salary range for this role is $145,000 - $163,000 + bonus + benefits

ABOUT EXTRAHOP 

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES 

Our culture is rooted in our five Values . These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team. 

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. 

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. 

BENEFITS 

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

- Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time

- Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today! 

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn .

title: Senior QA Engineer*
description:
Was dich erwartet

Bringe Qualität auf das nächste Level – bei unseren Kunden und in deinen Projekten. 
Du brennst für Softwarequalität, automatisierte Tests und moderne Tools? Du möchtest anspruchsvolle Projekte begleiten, Verantwortung übernehmen und deine Expertise im IT-Consulting einsetzen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams! 

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Testarchitekturen und -automatisierung: Dabei konzipierst und pflegst du Automatisierungsarchitekturen, sicherst die Qualität geschäftskritischer Anwendungen und entwickelst Testprozesse weiter.

- Du setzt moderne Automatisierungslösungen um: Mit Tools wie Playwright, REST Assured, Cucumber, Tricentis Tosca oder Cypress entwickelst du automatisierte Tests und integrierst sie nahtlos in CI/CD-Pipelines.

- Du planst und steuerst Tests – und berätst deine Kunden: Du koordinierst Testaktivitäten, leitest kleinere Teams und unterstützt Projekt- und Fachteams bei der Entwicklung von Teststrategien, Qualitätssicherung und Best Practices.

- Du analysierst und berichtest Ergebnisse: Du bewertest Testergebnisse, dokumentierst Abweichungen, beobachtest den Testfortschritt und leitest Optimierungen ein.

- Du arbeitest an vielfältigen Themen: Ob agile Teams, DevOps-Umfelder, Cloud- oder Mobile-Testing – du bringst deine Expertise ein und bleibst technologisch am Puls der Zeit.

Was du mitbringst

- Du hast mindestens 3-5 Jahre Praxiserfahrung im Bereich Softwaretest, Testautomatisierung oder Qualitätssicherung – idealerweise in einer beratenden Rolle.

- Du beherrschst mehrere Programmiersprachen – z. B. Java, Python, JavaScript oder Typescript – und fühlst dich sicher im Umgang mit Test- und Performance-Tools wie Playwright, Cucumber, JUnit, REST Assured, Tricentis Tosca, JMeter oder Gatling.

- Du kennst moderne Testkonzepte und - standards : Agiles Testen, risikobasierte Strategien oder exploratives Testdesign sind dir vertraut und eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung bringst du bereits mit.

- Idealerweise verfügst du zudem über Erfahrung im Bereich Barrierefreiheit (Accessibility Testing) sowie im Testen von und mit KI-basierten Anwendungen und Systemen .

- Du kommunizierst klar und adressatengerecht : Ob mit Entwicklern, Product Ownern oder Stakeholdern – du kannst Anforderungen aufnehmen, Ergebnisse präsentieren und Empfehlungen aussprechen. Erfahrung mit REST/SOAP-APIs ist ein Plus.

- Du bringst Teamgeist und Führungserfahrung mit: Du hast bereits kleinere Teams gesteuert oder Kolleg:innen fachlich begleitet und weiterentwickelt.

- Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und die Kommunikation auf Englisch stellt für dich kein Problem dar.

Worauf du dich freuen kannst - unsere Benefits

- Spannende Projekte: Du arbeitest an vielseitigen Kundenprojekten in einem professionellen Beratungsumfeld, in dem du deine Erfahrung und eigene Ideen einbringst, Verantwortung übernimmst und mit deinen Impulsen zum Game Changer im Projekt werden kannst.

- Flexibilität: Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag mit Homeoffice und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten individuell nach deinen Bedürfnissen. Für den persönlichen Austausch und unser Miteinander treffen wir uns einmal pro Woche vor Ort.

- Wissen teilen & gemeinsam wachsen: Ob Architektenschule, Skill Factories oder Gilden – bei uns gibt es viele Möglichkeiten, Wissen aufzubauen, zu teilen und voneinander zu lernen. Dabei kannst du deine Erfahrung einbringen und die fachliche Entwicklung deiner Kollegen mitgestalten.

- Teamgeist: Freu dich auf ein offenes und kollegiales Umfeld, in dem wir uns gegenseitig unterstützen, Wissen teilen und unterschiedliche Perspektiven schätzen.

- Gesundheit & Benefits: Du profitierst von Corporate Benefits, JobRad, einem Zuschuss zum Jobticket und – nach individueller Vereinbarung – Urban Sports Club. Mit unserer wöchentlichen „Bewegten Pause“ bringst du außerdem Bewegung und Mobilisierung in deinen Arbeitsalltag – im Büro oder im Homeoffice.

- Office zum Wohlfühlen: Helles, modernes Büro, leckerer Kaffee, eine Auswahl an Tees, ein gut gefüllter Getränkekühlschrank sowie frisches Obst und süße Snacks – bei uns stimmt auch das Drumherum.

- Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Ob Stammtisch, Spieleabend, Jahresauftakt oder Sommerfest – bei uns gibt es regelmäßig Gelegenheit, die Kollegen auch abseits des Projektalltags kennenzulernen.
* Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen Personen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. Menschen mit Behinderung werden bei gleicher Qualifikation bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Um die Lesbarkeit und Verständlichkeit zu fördern, haben wir in der gesamten Jobanzeige eine einheitliche Schreibweise gewählt. Diese dient ausschließlich der besseren Orientierung und beinhaltet keinerlei Wertung oder Ausschluss.
