title: Staff Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
description:
Who We Are 

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role 

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.

What You'll Do 

- Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production

- Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflows

- Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specific

- Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality

- Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product features

- Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)

- Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance

Who You Are 

- Extensive professional software engineering experience

- Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)

- Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs

- Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflows

- Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)

- You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified.

- A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate.

- You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does

- BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

Nice to Have 

- Experience building agentic systems (multi-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows)

- Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)

- Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting)

- Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container-based deployments

- Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality

Our Values 

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 

- Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 

- Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 

- Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 

- Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. title: Senior Data Scientist (Safety)
description:
Why Faculty? 

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here .

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team 

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions. 

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with our clients from time to time.

About the role 

As a Senior Data Scientist at Faculty, you will lead high-impact AI safety projects and shape the technical direction of upstream evaluation standards. This role requires hands-on scientific thinking and technical excellence combined with strong project leadership.

You will invent novel evaluation frameworks, design robust software architectures, mentor technical team members, and ensure delivery rigour across engagements—all while partnering with Frontier Labs to solidify our reputation as a leader in practical, high-stakes AI safety.

What you'll be doing: 

- Leading project teams that deliver upstream AI safety solutions and evaluation standards to Frontier Labs.

- Conceiving core scientific experiment designs and building the associated software architecture for new engagements.

- Mentoring technical team members on projects and supporting their professional growth through scientific guidance.

- Partnering with commercial teams to shape project scope, assess technical feasibility, and translate complex problems into rigorous frameworks.

- Contributing to Faculty’s thought leadership by advancing the science of AI evaluations, public speaking, or publishing open-source research.

- Ensuring rigorous scientific methodology and technical best practices are followed across the project lifecycle.

Who we're looking for: 

- You possess senior experience in a professional data science role, upstream safety research, or a quantitative academic field with strong experiment design methodology.

- You demonstrate strong programming skills in Python using core scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas) and , ideally, evaluation frameworks and tooling (e.g. Inspect AI) and agentic harnesses.

- You bring deep curiosity and expertise across the data science toolkit, with a drive to develop novel evaluation standards for specialized domains.

- You exhibit high technical rigor and a collaborative mindset focused on nurturing team capabilities and sharing technical knowledge.

- You demonstrate commercial awareness, with the ability to bridge complex scientific work with client requirements in Frontier Labs.

- You excel at scientific problem-solving, scoping technical work, and guiding project execution to meet high standards on structured timelines.

Our Interview Process 

- Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

- Take Home Technical Assessment

- Technical Interview (90 minutes)

- Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos 

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. 

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Software Engineer Intern - Financial Services
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

- 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

- ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

1. The Team You'll Join 

You'll be part of our Mirakl Labs Financial Services squad, based in Paris. The team is structured as a cross-functional Squad composed of a Senior Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, Software Engineers and a QA engineer. You'll be mentored by Wael Osmani, Software Engineer . You'll join a team that builds and ships the core product features powering some of the world's most ambitious marketplace platforms, with a particular focus on financial services capabilities. 

2. Your Impact 

- Contribute to the development and evolution of a production application, primarily on the frontend — from UI implementation to user experience improvements

- Support backend work by participating in API design and development, collaborating closely with the engineering team

- Work hand-in-hand with UX/UI designers to deliver features that are both technically solid and user-centric

- Take part in agile rituals — stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives — and contribute actively to the team's roadmap

- Monitor and take ownership of your contributions in production, following a you build it, you run it mindset

3. What You'll Bring to the Role 

Experience: 

- Currently pursuing a Master's degree (M1 or M2) in software engineering, computer science, or a related field, and looking for a 6-month internship

- First hands-on development experience through an internship, academic project, apprenticeship, or personal project

- Solid understanding of frontend development and object-oriented programming principles

Skills: 

- Proficiency or strong interest in frontend frameworks such as React or Angular , and in JavaScript/TypeScript 

- Familiarity with Java for backend and API development

- Curiosity for clean code, software quality, and working on production-grade applications

- A collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine drive to learn

4. Tech Stack 

- Back-end: Java 21, Spring Boot

- Front-end: ReactJS

- Data & Messaging: Kafka, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL

- Tooling & Practices: CI/CD, Git, Docker, Monitoring

5. Languages 

- French: Fluent

- English: Professional proficiency (written and spoken)

Compensation, Perks & Benefits 

- Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month

Our Hiring Process 

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

- Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter , then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma , Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.

- Recruiter interview (30 min) — conversation about your background, motivations, and an introduction to Mirakl

- Hiring Manager interview (45 min) — technical discussion covering Java and web development fundamentals, including practical exercises

- STAR interview (1h) — exchange with one or two team members exploring Mirakl's values and culture

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. 

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews .

title: Product Engineering
description:
Product Engineering at Polar 

Product engineering at Polar is about shaping and building the finance layer for the next generation of AI products. We’re rethinking how billing works for a world of usage-based software, programmable pricing and AI agents – from real-time metering and pricing as code, to more flexible customer identities, giving developers greater control over how they monetize their products.

We’re interested in engineers who enjoy working across our entire stack, solving complex technical challenges while shaping how developers interact with and experience Polar. We value engineers who think beyond implementation, challenge assumptions and bring the technical depth and product judgement to make sophisticated systems feel simple.

We operate as a small, remote-first team with a strong bias towards shipping. We value engineers who can work independently, collaborate when it matters and maintain a high bar for quality without sacrificing speed.

More about Polar and how we work 

What you could work on

Depending on your experience and where you can have the greatest impact, this could include:

- 
Own product development end-to-end: Identifying opportunities, shipping and iterating on features across our stack – taking responsibility for both the technical implementation and the product outcome.

- 
Build exceptional developer experiences: Bringing a strong eye for design, usability and detail to everything you ship. Turning complex billing and monetization workflows into intuitive interfaces, powerful APIs and thoughtful abstractions that make our merchants’ lives easier.

- 
Ship with speed and quality: Delivering improvements continuously, balancing fast iterations with robust engineering, performance and attention to detail.

- 
Stay close to our users: Engaging with our merchants, to understand how they use Polar, uncover pain points and translate feedback into meaningful product improvements.

What we look for

We’re particularly interested in senior engineers who combine strong technical foundations with exceptional product judgement and design sensibility. People who care deeply about developer experience, have opinions about what makes great software and know that building the right thing often means knowing what not to build.

Some of the qualities and experience we value in this area include:

- 
Strong technical foundations: Experience building, shipping and evolving production software, with deep expertise in at least one part of the stack and the ability to work confidently across frontend and backend systems. You’ve built and maintained products long enough to understand how early technical and product decisions hold up as they evolve and scale.

- 
Product judgement & design sensibility: A deep appreciation for how products look, feel and work. An understanding that developer experience is the product, from the clarity of an API to the smallest details of an interface. Strong opinions, loosely held, and the judgement to challenge assumptions, simplify complexity and know what to leave out.

- 
Ownership & pragmatic execution: The ability to take problems end-to-end with high ownership and autonomy, navigate ambiguity, make decisions without perfect information and take responsibility for outcomes. A bias towards shipping and knowing when to iterate quickly and when to invest in stronger foundations.

- 
Engineering craft: A commitment to the quality of what gets built – from clean APIs and robust backend logic to thoughtful interactions, edge-case handling and performance. High standards for both technical quality and the experience delivered.

- 
Curiosity & collaboration: A willingness to wear multiple hats, collaborate openly and contribute to a small team. Curiosity to learn new technologies and use tools, including AI-assisted development, while maintaining intimacy with the code, sound engineering judgement and ownership of what gets shipped.

Experience with payments, billing or developer tools is a strong plus.

We also love seeing open-source contributions and side projects.

Our stack

- 
Frontend: Typescript (React, Effect)

- 
Backend: Python (FastAPI, Dramatiq)

- 
Infrastructure: Postgres, Clickhouse, AWS.

title: Senior GenAI Consultant
description:

Als Senior GenAI Consultant leid je projecten waarin large language models, vector databases en Python-applicaties samenkomen tot robuuste oplossingen. Je bouwt geïntegreerde toepassingen die aansluiten op bestaande systemen en werkprocessen van klanten.

Je denkt verder dan tooling. Je begrijpt waar GenAI waarde toevoegt, waar niet, en weet dat helder uit te leggen aan stakeholders. Met jouw visie en ondernemende houding bouw je mee aan onze proposities, versterk je klantrelaties en help je het GenAI-team verder groeien.

Wat je doet 

- Leiden van GenAI-projecten met focus op waarde, schaalbaarheid en adoptie

- Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van GenAI-oplossingen zoals LLM-applicaties, RAG-architecturen, vector databases en document intelligence

- Integreren van AI-oplossingen in bestaande processen, platformen en systemen

- Presenteren van use cases, inzichten en resultaten aan klanten en stakeholders

- Meebouwen aan GenAI-services, proposities en herbruikbare bouwblokken

- Master of PhD in Data Science, Informatica, Kunstmatige Intelligentie of vergelijkbaar

- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen AI of Data Science, met focus op NLP en generatieve AI

- Sterke Python software engineering skills

- Ervaring met cloud-native AI-applicaties

- Praktische ervaring met LLM’s, vector databases en document intelligence

- Ervaring met integratie en deployment van AI-oplossingen in cloud- en dataplatformen

- Je kunt complexe concepten helder uitleggen aan business en stakeholders

- Ondernemende en visionaire mindset, gericht op klantwaarde en groei

Werken bij adesso 

Bij adesso Nederland werk je in een compact en snelgroeiend team van data- en AI-specialisten. We combineren klantprojecten met productontwikkeling: van herbruikbare GenAI-modules tot sectorgerichte oplossingen.

We pionieren, maar altijd met beide benen op de grond. Geen hype-gedreven trajecten, wel oplossingen die gebruikt worden en blijven werken.

Onze manier van werken is gebaseerd op vakmanschap, samenwerking en autonomie. Korte lijnen, weinig hiërarchie en veel ruimte voor initiatief.

- Open cultuur waarin kennisdeling en initiatief centraal staan

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden in Nederland en internationaal (11.000+ collega’s in Europa)

Onze Culture Code 

Bij adesso doen we niet aan loze kreten. Onze cultuur leeft en is zichtbaar in ons werk én onze samenwerking. De vier kernwaarden:

• We are straightforward – open en eerlijk

• We are open-minded – ruimte voor diversiteit en ideeën

title: Staff Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. 

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1917 

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will own product-level quality assurance: the system test plans, automation and compliance test execution that stand between an engineering release and a product customers can trust. In a security product, QA is not an afterthought; it is part of the evidence.

Responsibilities :

You will define and execute system-level test plans for FPGA-based cryptographic products: functional, performance, stress, stability and negative testing across the full stack, from hardware through firmware and drivers to cryptographic APIs. You will build and maintain the automated QA infrastructure (regression suites, hardware-in-the-loop test benches, CI integration, results dashboards), execute standards-based compliance test campaigns (NIST ACVP/CAVP test vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence runs, CNSA 2.0 checklists and standard FPGA compliance tests) together with our verification and security engineers, run interoperability testing against protocol stacks and customer-representative configurations, own defect tracking and triage, and define the release-qualification criteria for every product release.

- Own system-level QA of cryptographic hardware products: test plans, automation, execution and release qualification

- Execute standards and compliance test campaigns (ACVP/CAVP vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence, CNSA 2.0 and FPGA compliance tests) as part of the certification effort

Requirements: 

We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience) and at least five years in quality assurance or system test of embedded, hardware or networking products. You have built test automation in Python or similar, integrated it into CI, and worked hands-on with lab equipment and hardware-in-the-loop setups.

Exposure to security or compliance testing (FIPS, Common Criteria, or telecom/industrial certification regimes) is a strong plus, as is experience testing cryptographic or networking functionality. You are rigorous, methodical and precise in documentation, because in this product your test reports become certification evidence. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

- Experienced system-test/QA engineer for embedded or hardware products with strong automation skills

- Compliance or security test experience and meticulous documentation habits are strong advantages

Preferred Qualifications: 

You take professional pride in being the last line of defence before a release, you like breaking things methodically so customers never do, and you enjoy the extra weight QA carries when the product is a security device.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.

We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

US Technical Jobs. The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions. Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls. Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone. title: Principal Backend Engineer, Push
description:
About us 

Aave Labs began with a simple question: how do we make financial services like borrowing, saving, and earning more accessible globally?

We built the Aave Protocol, now the world’s largest and most trusted onchain lending market, connecting decentralized finance with individuals, traditional finance, and fintech.

Today, we build trusted, high-quality products that expand access to lending, credit, and savings globally

Our culture 

We build trusted products that help people access and discover economic opportunities.

We hold a high bar for quality and craftsmanship. No detail is too small. Trust depends on it.

We’re a global team building products people can actually use, turning complex technology into something simple and reliable.

We stay aligned, move quickly, and think long term, while keeping teams lean and focused on impact.

About the Role 

We're hiring a Principal Backend Engineer to lead the engineering team behind Push, Aave Labs' regulated, non-custodial on-ramp and off-ramp.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning the systems that connect banking and open-banking partners, identity and compliance controls, payment processing, blockchain settlement, customer wallets, and the applications through which customers access Push.

You'll set the technical direction for a high-stakes financial product where correctness, security, auditability, and operational resilience directly affect customer funds and regulatory obligations. Alongside designing and building critical systems, you'll provide day-to-day leadership to the engineering team, create clarity from product and regulatory requirements, and ensure the team can deliver safely at pace.

How you can make an impact: 

- Own the technical direction and architecture for Push across backend services, external integrations, data flows, and onchain settlement

- Translate product, regulatory, and operational requirements into a clear engineering roadmap, well-scoped projects, and sound technical decisions

- Design and build resilient services for on-ramp and off-ramp transaction lifecycles, including payment initiation, status tracking, settlement, exception handling, and customer notifications

- Lead integrations with open-banking, payments, identity, compliance, and blockchain infrastructure providers

- Define secure boundaries between fiat systems, non-custodial wallets, and onchain execution, ensuring sensitive data, permissions, and signing-related flows are handled appropriately

- Set and uphold standards for secure development, architecture review, testing, observability, incident response, deployment, and sustainable on-call ownership

- Partner closely with Product, Compliance, Legal, Security, Operations, Finance, and application engineers

- Remain hands-on in the codebase, particularly for complex architecture, high-risk changes, and critical production issues

Let's connect if you have: 

- 8+ years of backend engineering experience, including senior technical leadership of production systems and teams

- Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems that move or account for real money, with a strong understanding of failure modes and operational risk

- Experience with regulated financial products and understanding how to balance compliance and regulatory requirements with product features and goals 

- Strong backend programming skills. Production experience with Rust is highly desirable; deep experience with Go, Java, C++ can substitute

- Strong knowledge of API design, PostgreSQL or another relational database, messaging systems, and service-to-service integration patterns

- Experience in regulated fintech, payments, banking, digital assets, or another environment requiring auditability, controls, and high availability

- Excellent system-design judgement, including migration strategy, build-versus-buy decisions, security boundaries, and the long-term operational cost of architecture choices

- A track record of leading engineers through ambiguous, high-impact work while remaining close to implementation and production operations

Haven’t quite met all the criteria? Let’s not miss out on the chance to speak. Whilst you might not meet every single requirement, you might bring other, more exciting skills to the companies!

Aave Labs celebrates diversity and views each and every team member as a separate individual with their own unique identity. No matter your race, religion, gender, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation or even the wallet you use, we welcome you at Aave Labs. As an equal opportunities employer, we take accountability and believe in everyone's potential to build, create and inspire changes. With a mission to build a diverse workforce, we are proud to foster a working environment in which everyone can feel safe and valued for who they are.

title: Team Lead Software Engineer
description:
We’re Capital on Tap 
Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started! 

We opened our first Portuguese office in Porto in autumn 2025, and in less than a year it has grown to a team of 50. Lisbon is the next step. We're opening our first office in the city and looking for engineers to join as founding members of the team, helping shape how we build, hire and work here from day one.

The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

Salary: €70,000 - 90,000

What You’ll Be Doing 

We're looking for an Engineering Team Lead to lead one of our product engineering teams here at Capital on Tap.

This is a people-first leadership role. You'll be responsible for the growth, wellbeing, and performance of a team of engineers, while staying technically credible enough to shape direction, remove blockers, and raise the bar on quality. You won't be the best coder in the room you'll be the person who makes the whole room better.

If you're an experienced Team Lead Engineer looking to own a team in a scaling fintech, this role is built for you.

What You'll Own

Your team. Hiring, developing, and retaining engineers. Running 1:1s that actually matter. Spotting who's ready to grow and creating the space for them to do it.

Delivery. Partnering with Product and QA to plan and ship reliably not by micromanaging, but by removing obstacles, managing risk, and keeping the team focused on what matters.

Culture. Setting the tone for how the team communicates, gives feedback, and holds itself accountable. Building psychological safety without sacrificing standards.

Technical credibility. You won't be heads-down in the codebase every day, but you'll understand the trade-offs your team is navigating architecture decisions, technical debt, build vs buy and contribute meaningfully to those conversations.

What We're Looking For

Leadership first. You've managed engineers before and have a point of view on what good looks like. You know how to have hard conversations, give developmental feedback, and motivate people.

Technical foundation in .NET. Our backend is C#/.NET Core and you'll need enough depth to earn trust with your engineers, review decisions, and spot risks. You don't need to be across every layer of the stack you need to be honest about what you know and curious about what you don't.

Product mindset. You think about engineering in the context of business outcomes, not just technical correctness. You can push back on scope, advocate for quality, and translate between engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Comfort with ambiguity. Capital on Tap is growing. Priorities shift. We want someone who creates clarity for their team rather than waiting for it.

Nice to Have

- Experience with Azure cloud development

- Familiarity with React or other frontend frameworks

- Background in financial services or fintech

Diversity & Inclusion 
We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Interview Process 

- First stage: 30 minute intro call with Talent Partner

- Second stage: 60 minute "Tech Chat" & Values Interview with an Engineering Manager & People Partner

- Third stage: 60 minute Code Pairing with our Engineering Team

- Final stage: 60 minute Case Study with Product & Engineering + 60 minute Good to Great Interview with our CTO

Great Work Deserves Great Perks 

Check out our benefits:

Private Healthcare through AdvanceCare
Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)

️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend)
Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget
6 free therapy sessions per year
Free drinks and snacks in our offices

Other Info
Check out our ‘Top Tips’ for interviewing. 
✔️Keep updated on new job opportunities by following us on Linkedin .
Email careers@capitalontap.com if you have any questions.

title: Solutions Architect (EST or PST hours)
description:
Company Overview 

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm 

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: This individual must be based in either Eastern or Pacific Time in the US. or willing to work during these time zone work hours

Opportunity
Deepgram is seeking a talented, support-focused Solutions Architect (Applied Engineer) to join our Applied Engineering (AppEng) team. In this role, you will directly engage with customers to solve complex technical challenges while simultaneously building scalable solutions that enhance our support infrastructure. You'll own complete customer engagements in a post-sales capacity, and occasionally assist with pre-sales and implementation projects as needed. Your strong engineering background will enable you to resolve sophisticated technical issues, create repeatable solutions, and develop automation that allows the broader AppEng team to focus on high-impact pre-sales activities. This position offers an excellent path to grow into broader implementation and pre-sales roles while making an immediate impact on our customer support experience. As a key member of the Applied Engineering team, you'll influence our customer support strategy, and play a crucial role in ensuring our customers receive exceptional technical assistance throughout their journey with Deepgram.

About Applied Engineering at Deepgram
The Applied Engineering (AppEng) team at Deepgram combines the functions that other companies might separate into Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Implementation, and Technical Support. We serve as the technical interface between Deepgram and our customers throughout their entire journey, from initial discovery and proof-of-concept, through implementation and onboarding, to ongoing technical support. We work closely with our Customer Success and Developer Experience (DX) teams to ensure a positive, growth-focused experience for our customers. This unified approach allows us to provide comprehensive technical guidance and build deeper relationships with our customers. As a support-focused Applied Engineer, you'll be primarily concerned with elevating our technical support capabilities while having opportunities to contribute to the broader Applied Engineering mission in pre-sales, implementation, and more.

What you'll do 

- 
Own the technical design and delivery of customer implementations and migrations, from kickoff through production cutover

- 
Lead deployment scaling work, including capacity planning, rollout sequencing, and verification methodology

- 
Design solutions that fit each customer's existing stack, constraints, and operational shape

- 
Partner with Customer Success and Account Executives on customer-side change management, including readiness, stakeholder alignment, and rollout communication

- 
Develop reusable implementation patterns, reference architectures, and deployment playbooks that the broader AppEng team and customers can reuse

- 
Create automation and self-service tooling that compresses time-to-value for repeatable implementation work

- 
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and influence the roadmap based on patterns observed in active deployments

- 
Provide support for the most complex post-onboarding cases when escalation crosses into Solutions Architect territory

- 
Occasionally support pre-sales technical work, including discovery, scoping, and proof-of-concept design

Time allocation 

- 
50% — Customer implementation and scaling engagements

- 
20% — Building reusable patterns, reference architectures, and automation

- 
15% — Pre-sales technical support, including discovery, demos, and proof-of-concepts

- 
10% — Documentation and knowledge sharing

- 
5% — Complex post-onboarding escalations and collaboration with Technical Support Engineers

Your first 90 days 

- 
First 30 days — Complete comprehensive onboarding to understand Deepgram's technology, products, and the patterns we use for implementations. Gain proficiency with our core APIs and documentation. Shadow active implementation engagements to build familiarity with how the AppEng team operates during customer change phases.

- 
60 days — Begin owning customer implementation engagements end-to-end, leading technical design and partnering with Customer Success on rollout. Start contributing to reusable implementation patterns and reference architectures.

- 
90 days — Own the technical delivery of multiple concurrent customer implementations. Develop and deliver scalable solutions for repeatable customer change patterns. Begin contributing to the Applied Engineering team's implementation methodology and mentoring newer team members.

You'll love this role if you... 

- 
Enjoy seeing customer technical environments transformed through careful implementation work

- 
Are passionate about reducing the time it takes any customer to reach production value with Deepgram

- 
Find satisfaction in designing patterns that scale beyond a single customer engagement

- 
Have a talent for identifying recurring needs across customers and translating them into reusable artifacts

- 
Are energized by deploying cutting-edge Voice AI in production environments with real customers

- 
See implementation work as a strategic function that drives customer growth and retention

It's important to us that you have 

- 
3+ years of experience implementing or deploying technical solutions for enterprise customers, ideally in customer-facing technical roles

- 
Strong software engineering background with professional development experience in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, Rust, C / C++, or similar languages

- 
Experience leading technical delivery of production deployments, from design through cutover

- 
Proven ability to scope complex technical work and sequence it for successful delivery

- 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering and business stakeholders alike

It would be great if you had 

- 
Experience with speech recognition, natural language processing, AI Voice agents, or related AI technologies

- 
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes

- 
Experience with API-first products and developer tools

- 
Background in change-management or implementation methodology

- 
Experience producing reference architectures, deployment playbooks, or implementation templates

Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

title: Energy Markets - France (CDD)
description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here .

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

- Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

- Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

- Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

- Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

- Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

- Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

- Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

- Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

- Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

- Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

- Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

- Initial interview

- Take-home exercise

- Final interview (in-person)

- Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
About CHAPTERS Group 

CHAPTERS Group is a listed German serial acquirer of vertical market software companies. We have grown 10x in the past five years and now own 55+ companies. Each one runs its own business, close to its customers. We help them get stronger without taking over. AI is one of the biggest opportunities we see for them, and it only works if the people in these companies actually use it.

Tasks

The Role 
German (C1+) and English required

You make sure 10+ software companies get real value out of AI.

You work embedded in one of our portfolio platforms. You own the AI Hub for its companies. The AI Hub is our Open WebUI-based AI platform: each company has its own instance in its own tenant, and the data stays in the EU. You keep it running, roll it out, fix what breaks, and help each company's people use it well.

You are part of the AI Core Team in the CTO office. You work closely with us: you bring back what you see in the field, test new capabilities, and help shape the platform for all 55+ companies.

You are hands-on. You deploy, configure, fix and integrate. Each company also has AI Champions who drive adoption locally. You are their technical backbone: when something needs engineering, you do it, and you make sure the next similar request is faster.

What You Will Do

- Run the AI Hub for 10+ companies: deployments, updates, configuration, SSO with Entra ID, monitoring, backups and incident handling

- Onboard companies and teams: set up skills, knowledge bases and tools and get each company productive on the Hub

- Be the technical point of contact: when something breaks or a Champion is stuck, you diagnose and fix it. You document recurring issues so they get solved once.

- Connect the Hub where a use case needs it: Microsoft 365 / Graph, CRM, ticketing and ERP systems, through tools, MCP servers and REST APIs

- Turn repeated questions into reusable assets: documentation, templates and short hands-on sessions

- Work with the AI Core Team: share patterns across companies, test new features, and feed back into the platform roadmap

- Support our M&A team occasionally (around 10 to 20% of your time) on technical questions, for example assessing the tech and AI stack of acquisition targets

What We Are Looking For

Required 

- German (C1 or higher) and fluent English. You work with managing directors and non-technical teams in German every day. We cannot make exceptions here.

- Production operations experience. You have deployed and operated containerised applications in production (Docker, CI/CD, Linux, a major cloud, Azure preferred), and you were responsible when they broke. This usually means 2+ years in a DevOps, platform, SRE or backend role.

- Python you are comfortable reading, debugging and extending

- Hands-on with LLMs. You use them seriously in your own work and have built something with them, at work or on the side. You know where they fail.

- You explain technical things so non-technical people understand them and can act on them. You are comfortable being the go-to technical person for teams that are not technical.

Strong signals 

- Enterprise identity: Entra ID, OAuth, SSO

- Self-hosted LLM platforms such as Open WebUI or LibreChat

- MCP, tool calling, agent frameworks

- Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform)

- A support, solutions or customer-facing technical role in your background

- Experience working across several companies, tenants or a group structure

This role is not for you if 

- you want to spend most of your time building new AI products from scratch

- you are looking for ML research or model training

- you want to work only with engineers and avoid direct contact with business teams

Benefits

What You Get

- Real ownership: 10+ companies, one platform, and you are the person who makes AI work there

- A small team in the CTO office with a direct line to leadership. Decisions get made fast.

- Impact beyond your platform: what works for your companies becomes the standard for 55+

- Permanent full-time position , remote-first, with occasional on-site time

- Development: talent reviews, events and conferences. We hire people who want to grow with us.

How to Apply 

Send your CV and answer this one question in German , max. 200 words. No cover letter needed.

- Tell us about a system you ran in production that broke. What happened, what did you do, and what changed afterwards?

We are looking forward to your application!

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
About Supabase 

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We are hiring a AI Platform Engineer to build the execution layer for Supabase's internal AI systems.

Supabase is building an AI-native internal operating system: a common way of working across the company where AI carries a meaningful share of the operational load rather than sitting alongside it as an assistant. We are standing up a new central team to build those systems, enable the teams, and embed AI operations throughout the organization. You are the engineer on that team.

The execution layer is yours. You will build the platform that actually runs agents: an event-triggered queue, a headless model-agnostic runtime, durable state so work survives a restart, a human review gate, atomic rollback, and full logging of every prompt, tool call and decision so any run can be reconstructed. You will build the evaluation layer that makes any of it trustworthy, because an agent that cannot be measured cannot be trusted with anything beyond reading. And you will build the agents themselves, across everything from executive reporting down to a layer of agents that watch the platform and improve it.

This is a governance-heavy environment by design, and that is the interesting part of the problem. Agents are risk-tiered from read-only internal data through to external-facing output, with review depth, evaluation requirements and human approval scaling by tier. Some capabilities are permanently off limits: an agent may read and report, it may carry a human-authored update into a system of record once a human consents, and it may initiate contact within a strict budget, but it may never autonomously write a commitment (an owner, a due date, a status) into a shared work system. Your job is to make that structurally impossible rather than merely forbidden.

You will be the only engineer on this platform. You will close open architecture decisions yourself, own the infrastructure end to end, and instrument the system so it reports its own return.

What You'll Be Responsible For

In this role, you'll:

- 
Ship the agent platform to production. An event-triggered queue, a headless model-agnostic runtime (choosing the runtime is an open decision you will close), durable state that survives a failed run, a human review gate, atomic rollback, and complete run logging in the warehouse.

- 
Own the evaluation layer, and switch on the gate that depends on it. Golden suites with behavioral assertions rather than intuition, judge criteria with a written rubric, safety cases that must pass on every run, and a CI gate that blocks a regression from merging. This is the precondition for every agent that does anything beyond read internal data.

- 
Build and register the agent portfolio. Reporting, drafting, linting, triage and question-answering agents across the executive, team-lead and individual-contributor layers, plus a meta layer that observes the platform and improves it.

- 
Enforce governance in code. Risk tiers the pipeline actually enforces, least-privilege credentials per agent, tool-permission gates, a decision audit log, and autonomy classes where the dangerous class has no code path rather than a warning label. Nothing runs without a registered owner, tier, tool grant and human gate.

- 
Design how the system contacts people. A hard interruption budget per person, message bundling instead of a stream of pings, and a structure that gives something useful before it asks for anything. Adoption depends on this more than on any other single design choice.

- 
Own the platform tooling. The compiler and validator, inventory integrity, and the paths that distribute context and capabilities into the repositories and chat surfaces where work happens.

- 
Compute the operating measures from production data. A pipeline from raw system activity through to a computed maturity grade per team, defensible enough that a team can dispute the result and be answered with the query rather than an opinion.

- 
Instrument the platform's own return. A ledger that logs the work each agent absorbs and computes the monthly figure, so the value of the system is a measurement rather than a claim.

How You'll Think

Recursive Thinking

You build the generator, not the artifact. When you need thirty agents, you do not write thirty agents; you build the inventory, the compiler and the distribution path that makes the thirty-first cost an afternoon, then a meta layer whose job is to watch the platform, find its drift and file the fix.

The evaluation layer is the same move applied to trust. You are not checking whether one agent is correct today. You are building the machine that decides whether every future agent is allowed to ship, which means the suite has to be right in a way the agent does not, and the thing that grades has to be graded too.

Inversion Thinking

You start from the failure and work backward to the design. The rule is that an agent may never autonomously write a commitment into a shared work system. The weak implementation is an instruction in a prompt. The strong one is that the credential in the agent's tool grant physically cannot set an owner, a due date or a status, so no amount of clever input, prompt injection or model error produces the forbidden write. You reach for the second one first.

Same for evaluation. Before writing a suite you enumerate how the agent can be wrong: an update that invents progress that did not happen, one that quotes a private channel into a public digest, one that is accurate and reads as an accusation, one that credits the wrong person. Then the suite is that list, each case caught before the agent ships rather than after it embarrasses someone.

AI-Native Execution

You use agentic tools on real work, in files and repositories, with the same rigor you apply to anything else you ship. You have a setup of your own and can describe it mechanically: what triggers it, what it is allowed to touch, where the human approves, what it logs, and how you found out the one time it went wrong.

That experience is this job, generalized. You are building for async engineers across 40+ countries who will judge the platform by whether it saves them an hour or costs them one, so you are your own first user and your own harshest reviewer.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Must Have

- 
Have shipped production LLM agent systems that other people depended on. Not demos, not internal showcases. Systems with operational history, real users and at least one incident you can talk through. Prompt engineering on its own does not clear this bar.

- 
Design evaluations, not spot checks. You build golden sets, write behavioral assertions, define judge rubrics, set pass thresholds and gate CI on the result. You can explain why "we reviewed a bunch of outputs and they looked good" is not evaluation.

- 
Have done deep API work against the systems work actually lives in , and have authored MCP servers. You know the specific failure modes of those APIs, not just that they exist.

- 
Own infrastructure end to end in Python on GCP, with a cloud warehouse and infrastructure as code. You provision, deploy, monitor and roll back your own systems, and you close architecture decisions rather than routing them onward.

- 
Have taste about how software contacts humans. You treat every notification as spending a limited amount of trust.

Strong Signal

- 
Public work in this space. An open-source agent framework, an MCP server, an evaluation harness, or writing on agent reliability that other practitioners cite.

- 
LLM observability and cost instrumentation. Tracing agent runs, attributing spend per run, and building the queries that turn raw logs into a report someone acts on.

- 
You have built an internal platform that non-engineers adopted voluntarily , and can describe what you changed after watching them use it.

What Success Looks Like

- 
The platform is boring. Agents run on a schedule and on events, state survives restarts, failed runs roll back cleanly, and every run can be reconstructed from its log.

- 
Nothing ships unevaluated. Every registered agent has a real suite with safety cases, the gate blocks regressions, and when someone challenges an output the answer is a test case rather than an argument.

- 
The dangerous action is impossible, not discouraged. An audit of any agent's credentials shows it cannot perform the writes it is not allowed to perform, and the audit log makes every consequential decision traceable.

- 
Teams pull the platform instead of being pushed. Agents get adopted because the reports are useful and the contact is rare and well-timed, and each team ends up with at least one workflow that runs automatically.

- 
The platform reports its own value. The work absorbed is measured and published, so the case for expanding it is made with data rather than enthusiasm.

What We Offer 

- 
Fully Remote 

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- 
ESOP 

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- 
Tech Allowance 

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- 
Health Benefits 

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- 
Annual Off-Sites 

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- 
Flexible Work 

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- 
Professional Development 

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team 

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- 
~400 team members

- 
60+ countries

- 
20+ languages spoken

- 
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

- Being open to change and feedback

Important Notice: While we don't currently have an immediate opening for a Backend Engineer in Portugal, we're proactively building a talent pipeline for future opportunities. If your profile aligns with what we're looking for, we'd love to consider you as new positions become available.

Your Mission 

On our path to becoming the most visited online curated marketplace for special objects, our Engineering team is on a mission to deliver the best experience across our platforms by building best-in-class products for search and discovery, bidding, curation, logistics, payments, and support.

We’re a scale-up tackling customer-facing challenges at high scale, with 75,000 auctions per week and more than 10 million visitors per month. As a Backend Engineer , you’ll support one of our three verticals - Demand , Supply , or Fulfilment - improving and delivering product innovations for our platform.
Working in a small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile team, you will build scalable, maintainable, and resilient microservices and features. That’s why we’re looking for developers who share ideas, explore options, and communicate openly.

What You'll Do 

You’ll be part of a team with end-to-end responsibility for its own microservices, collaborating across disciplines to build, operate, and continuously improve our products.

- Build end-to-end by designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving scalable microservices and features.

- Own what you deliver , taking responsibility for the quality, resilience, and maintainability of your team’s services throughout their lifecycle.

- Collaborate across disciplines while closely working with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile engineers to share ideas and deliver product innovations.

- Improve how we work , identifying opportunities to make our engineering processes more effective and efficient.

- Strengthen our engineering culture by documenting and advocating for development best practices across the team.

- Raise product quality by fixing bugs and refactoring the codebase where necessary to keep our products reliable and maintainable.

- Learn and experiment by testing new technologies and participating in Technical Week - a week dedicated to creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains after every two product sprints.

What You'll Bring 

You understand the full lifecycle of web development, identify opportunities, explore solutions, and keep customer needs at the center of your work. Our stack is mainly focused on Ruby; however, prior Ruby experience is not essential if you’re passionate about learning new things.

- Strong software engineering foundations: 7+ years of software development experience, specifically with object-oriented programming.

- Relevant product experience: 3+ years of experience working with customer-facing products in industries such as e-commerce, fintech, or SaaS.

- Backend service expertise: Experience designing, implementing, and deploying backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency, and consistency.

- API and data knowledge: A good understanding of API design, SQL, and relational databases.

- Clear communication: Excellent English communication skills and comfort raising concerns, sharing ideas, and documenting your work.

- Collaborative mindset: You contribute to the team, take initiative, and step in to help when needed.

- Solution-oriented thinking: You actively identify opportunities and explore alternative approaches to solving problems.

- Commitment to growth: You take ownership of developing your skills by learning new technologies and seeking new opportunities.

How We Work 

Our engineers work in small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile teams aligned with one of three verticals: Demand, Supply, or Fulfilment.

- Teams are responsible for their own microservices from design and development through deployment, maintenance, and improvement.

- Engineers collaborate closely with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile colleagues.

- We value bold thinking, curiosity, openness, initiative, and a strong customer focus.

- Technical Week creates dedicated space for experimentation, creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains.

Where You'll Be 

This is a Hybrid role based in Lisbon. You will work from our Lisbon Hub a minimum of 2 days per week. 
At this time, we are only considering candidates who are already based in Portugal . As a result, visa sponsorship and relocation support are not available for this position.

In Return 

You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians. 

- A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.

- Meal Allowance Card stipend per working day, in addition to salary.

- Health Insurance from day 1 (including dental coverage), with access to multiple hospitals and clinics and a vast wellness network.

- A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.

- Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.

- Amazing Office right in the centre of Lisbon.

Why You'll Love Working with Us 

- Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.

- Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.

- A culture of connection defines us . We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.

- Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion ” . We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working 

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested? 

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. 

The Data & Automations Team

The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability.

The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions.

Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver.

The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

Role

As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams.

You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written.

Tech environment

Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work.

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Under the supervision of the Data & Automations team's more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.

Data Platform & Infrastructure: 

- Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from APIs, databases, and SaaS tools, using Fivetran, Airflow, and Python

- Build and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, documented, and tested datasets

- Contribute to the evolution of our orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code setup

- Help improve data quality, observability, and alerting across the platform

G&A and GTM Data Pipelines & Automations: 

- Build pipelines and integrations that sync data between business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS) through our data warehouse, including reverse ETL with Hightouch

- Develop Python-based automations that remove manual work for teams such as Finance, People, IT, and Customer Success

- Prepare reliable datasets for reporting and for the Pigment applications used by business teams

AI Projects:
